sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r12/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 6 (check 5) and Internal Quality Checks row 6 (no extra annotation text on that row); Deterministic Checks C14 check-instruction-hygiene.py
.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r12/task/tests/**/*.md and *.toml (machine comparison of criterion ids, names, quoted literals and word n-grams against the public text; not read line by line)
evidence: Applied the skill's procedure (quality-checks.md section 5). (1) Case-insensitive grep for judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score\.py|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel, widened with gate|probe|grader|grade|verif|functional|polish|visual|oracle|checker|harbor|likert|cw_, over task/instruction.md, all six environment/instructions/*.md, environment/assets/seed_data.json and environment/Dockerfile returned zero matches. (2) None of the 54 criterion/judge ids found by id = "..." in tests/**/*.toml (the cw_ family), and none of the name = values, appears in the public text. (3) No quoted, backticked or upper-case/digit-bearing literal from the judge prompts, criteria or app_context.md appears in the public text other than the ordinary words 'HTML' and 'saved'; no probe or sentinel value is published. (4) Verbatim overlap: no shared run of 7 or more words between any public file and any tests .md/.toml; only three 6-word runs exist and all are ordinary product prose ('counted from the first line of', 'draft that has a syntax error', 'the preview the console and the'). (5) Manual read of all public lines: the only harness-adjacent statements are the product runtime contract in integration.md:3-11 ('We start it with node /app/server.js from a working directory that may be outside /app', 'If DB_PATH is set, open that absolute path instead', the symbolic-link rule) and policy.md:5 ('The examples are ways to explain it, not exact selectors, CSS classes or implementation requirements'). These describe how the app is launched and what is left to the builder; they name no judge, rubric, dimension, weight, test path or sentinel, and the frozen template's own integration.md states the same kind of launch contract (/app/server.js, port 3000, DB_PATH, GET /api/health). The agent Dockerfile copies only instructions/ and assets/. This row is a static text property, so the absence of a configured judge run on these bytes does not leave it unmeasured; the private check-instruction-hygiene.py was not executed and its result is not claimed here.
